title: 품질 시험 결과 (perf_db reader)
description: Local dashboard: SPEC-0203 project reader RLS; no datasource or credential is created. Empty project selects no rows. Compare only identical scenario, budgets and interfaces; no percentile averaging or automatic verdict. Missing evidence/object references remain visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.project_id, r.run_id, r.attempt, r.execution_state, r.reported_verdict, r.official_verdict, r.evidence_state, r.started_at, r.ended_at, r.samples FROM quality.run_results r WHERE r.project_id IN (${project_id:sqlstring}) AND ('*' IN (${run_id:sqlstring}) OR r.run_id::text IN (${run_id:sqlstring})) AND ('*' IN (${attempt:sqlstring}) OR r.attempt::text IN (${attempt:sqlstring})) ORDER BY r.ended_at DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 500

SELECT r.project_id, r.run_id, r.attempt, a.name, a.sha256, a.bytes, a.object_ref FROM quality.run_results r JOIN quality.artifacts a USING (project_id, run_id, attempt) WHERE r.project_id IN (${project_id:sqlstring}) AND ('*' IN (${run_id:sqlstring}) OR r.run_id::text IN (${run_id:sqlstring})) AND ('*' IN (${attempt:sqlstring}) OR r.attempt::text IN (${attempt:sqlstring})) ORDER BY r.ended_at DESC NULLS FIRST, a.name LIMIT 500

SELECT r.project_id, r.run_id, r.attempt, m.name, m.metric_type, m.contains, m.values AS current_values, b.values AS baseline_values, m.thresholds FROM quality.run_results r JOIN quality.metric_summaries m USING (project_id, run_id, attempt) LEFT JOIN quality.metric_summaries b ON b.project_id = m.project_id AND b.name = m.name AND b.metric_type = m.metric_type AND b.contains = m.contains AND b.run_id::text IN (${baseline_run_id:sqlstring}) AND b.attempt::text IN (${baseline_attempt:sqlstring}) WHERE r.project_id IN (${project_id:sqlstring}) AND ('*' IN (${run_id:sqlstring}) OR r.run_id::text IN (${run_id:sqlstring})) AND ('*' IN (${attempt:sqlstring}) OR r.attempt::text IN (${attempt:sqlstring})) ORDER BY r.ended_at DESC NULLS FIRST, m.name LIMIT 500
